title: Hokage Jack Sparrows
tagline: Used AI to generate 25 different images of Jack Sparrow in the style of Naruto. Made them into a free to mint NFT collection with no code.
description:
I came here solo and I'm not really a dev, but still wanted to get something out there. Tried to build a proper app first, but failed. Thought it would be interesting to just ship something with no code.

Used a Stable Diffusion variant to generate 25 different drawings of Jack Sparrow in the style of Naruto.

Made them into a an NFT collection using different no-code tools.
how_its_made:
My no code stack:

First I generated the 25 images manually using this: https://huggingface.co/spaces/lambdalabs/text-to-naruto

Then I deployed a basic NFT contract from the Thirdweb dashboard, and batch uploaded a json file with the metadata and images.

I used OpenZeppelin to forward the gas fees so its free to mint (even though its on testnet lol).

Then I embedded the mint component into a TypeDream side as an iframe.
